# ORIONS — Stories, refined.

ORIONS is a story-led creative company based in Bangkok. It helps brands uncover, connect, refine and express the stories that make them worth remembering.

## Positioning
- Primary line: Stories, refined.
- Belief: We don't invent stories. We reveal them.
- Approach: Meaning before medium.
- Work: Different formats. One story.

## What ORIONS does
ORIONS works through three movements. Each answers a different client question,
and each starts from what the brand already has.

Expand — Build what comes next. When the question is "where do we grow next?".
Existing brand equity, capability and cultural relevance are carried into a new
space: product, service, experience, collaboration, activation, category or
business opportunity. From brand equity to new value.

Reframe — Change the way it is seen. When the question is "who else could this
matter to?". The context around an existing product changes so it means
something to another audience, in another moment, for another reason, without
replacing the product itself: unseen audience, emerging behaviour, alternative
use case, new occasion, cultural context, demand territory, communication
angle. Same product. Different relevance.

Embed — Make the brand live everywhere. When the question is "how do we keep it
all feeling like us?". A creative foundation puts the brand's identity into
every expression — narrative, tone, visual language, behaviour, content,
product expression, digital experience, service, customer journey. Touchpoints
need not look alike, but they share the same point of view. One identity. Many
expressions.

Expand opens possibility. Reframe creates relevance. Embed builds coherence.

## How any movement is made
Story — brand strategy, positioning, research, narrative and messaging.
Direction — creative direction, identity, art direction and campaign direction.
Expression — film, photography, content, digital experience and production.
Film & Visual Story is a craft, not a movement: the screen is a way to carry
meaning, never the starting point.

## Ways to work together
- Brand Foundation: find the story before building the brand. This sits before
  the three movements — each of them starts from something that already exists,
  and a brand built from nothing has none of it yet.
- Creative Launch (Expand): turn an opening or release into a meaningful moment.
- Campaign Platform (Reframe): one idea across many expressions.
- Brand Refine (Reframe): keep the brand and make its story clearer.
- Creative Partnership (Embed): ongoing senior creative thinking and direction.

The right scope depends on the client's question and context.
